title: Kursi Tiga A
subject: On his first flight as co-pilot, a young Garuda pilot from Padang makes the cabin announcement and hears his own mother in seat 3A answer back, with fourteen relatives filling rows three to seven waving at the cockpit door.
caption: Indonesian horn funk, Jakarta 1970s funk-pop style. Tight clean electric guitar in choppy sixteenth-note scratch rhythm, slap electric bass with a syncopated groove, trumpet, tenor sax and trombone playing short stabs, Rhodes electric piano comping, drum kit with crisp snare and open hi-hat. dry punchy 1970s funk studio mix, tight drums, horn stabs panned wide. Male vocal, warm mid-high register, bright playful delivery, clearly sung with horn answers. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 108 BPM, E minor. Comic, nervous, proud. No rap, no autotune, no trap hi-hats, no EDM synths, no distorted guitar, no orchestral strings.
lyrics:
[Intro - scratch guitar and horn stabs]
[Verse 1]
Penerbangan pertamaku jadi kopilot
Jakarta ke Padang, pagi masih gelap
Kubuka pengeras suara, kuhela napas
Selamat pagi para penumpang sekalian
[Pre-Chorus]
Dari kursi tiga A ada suara
Itu ibuku, jawab dengan lantang
[Chorus]
"Nak, jangan lupa sabuk pengaman!"
Satu pesawat tertawa bersama
Kursi tiga sampai tujuh keluargaku
Semua melambai ke pintu kokpit
[Verse 2]
Om Dedi bawa rendang sekardus
Tante Ani foto-foto di lorong
Pramugari bingung mau bilang apa
Kapten cuma geleng sambil tersenyum
[Pre-Chorus]
Kuumumkan cuaca cerah di Padang
Ibu bilang, "Betul itu anakku!"
[Chorus]
"Nak, jangan lupa sabuk pengaman!"
Satu pesawat bertepuk tangan
Kursi tiga sampai tujuh keluargaku
Semua melambai ke pintu kokpit
[Chorus]
"Nak, duduk dulu, pintu belum dibuka!"
Kuumumkan itu lewat pengeras suara
Kursi tiga sampai tujuh keluargaku
Mereka duduk lagi, bangga setengah mati
[Outro - funk groove with horn stabs]
Terima kasih, selamat datang di Padang
